biotools.summary: HIDE-Deconv is a framework for characterizing cellular remodeling from bulk RNA-seq data using hierarchical cell-type deconvolution across multiple levels of cellular resolution. It provides an integrated workflow for single-cell reference preprocessing, estimation of cellular compositions, and downstream analysis of deconvolution results, including visualization, clustering, differential composition, and survival analysis.
